intro.uz: Bir bola uyini tasvirlaydi. Oʻqishdan oldin: sizning xonangizda nimalar bor?

paragraphs.en: We live in a flat in Chilonzor. It is on the fourth floor. The building has a lift, but it is often broken!
paragraphs.uz: Biz Chilonzordagi kvartirada yashaymiz. U toʻrtinchi qavatda. Binoda lift bor, lekin u tez-tez buzilib qoladi!

paragraphs.en: Our flat has three rooms, a kitchen and a bathroom. The living room is big. There is a sofa, a TV and a big carpet on the floor. My grandmother's room is next to the kitchen.
paragraphs.uz: Kvartiramizda uchta xona, oshxona va hammom bor. Mehmonxona katta. U yerda divan, televizor va polda katta gilam bor. Buvimning xonasi oshxonaning yonida.

paragraphs.en: My room is small, but I love it. There is a bed, a desk and a bookshelf. My computer is on the desk. From my window I can see a park.
paragraphs.uz: Mening xonam kichkina, lekin men uni yaxshi koʻraman. Unda karavot, yozuv stoli va kitob javoni bor. Kompyuterim stol ustida. Derazamdan bogʻni koʻra olaman.

grammar.example: There is a bed, a desk and a bookshelf.
My computer is on the desk.

questions.statement: The family lives in a house.

explain.uz: Ular kvartirada yashaydi: «We live in a flat».

questions.prompt: Which floor is the flat on?

explain.uz: Lift tez-tez buziladi: «it is often broken».

questions.prompt: What is on the floor in the living room?

explain.uz: «a big carpet on the floor» — bu yerda floor = pol.

questions.statement: The grandmother's room is next to the bathroom.

explain.uz: Buvining xonasi oshxona yonida: «next to the kitchen».

questions.prompt: From the window you can see a ___.

explain.uz: «From my window I can see a park.»
